parties: Landmark Cars Limited (promoter: Sanjay Karsandas Thakker)
headline: Landmark Cars Files Regulation 31(4) SAST Disclosure on Promoter Shareholding
sum: Sanjay Karsandas Thakker filed a mandatory Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE, confirming the promoter group's shareholding in Landmark Cars Limited as of 31 March 2026. The filing details shareholding patterns of the promoter and persons acting in concert (PAC), with no encumbrances created during FY26.
implication: Routine periodic disclosures under SAST Regulations require legal teams to ensure timely cross-filing to NSE/BSE and accurate substantiation of PAC status in promoter structures—particularly where family entities hold material stakes.
detail: <cite index="1-3,1-7">Sanjay Karsandas Thakker holds the largest stake within the promoter group with 1.5 crore shares (1,50,69,768 shares).</cite> <cite index="1-8">Other key shareholders include Ami Sanjay Thakker from the promoter group with 53,34,848 shares, and promoters Udayan Karsandas Thakker and Richa Udayan Thakker, each holding 65,000 shares.</cite> <cite index="1-4,1-9">The filing confirms no encumbrances were created on these shares during FY26.</cite> <cite index="1-10">The declaration was signed by Sanjay Karsandas Thakker on behalf of the promoter and persons acting in concert.</cite>
